summary.text: Kevin Lincoln II is a Republican and U.S. Marine Corps veteran who describes himself as a security company executive and pastor. He was elected mayor of Stockton in 2020, serving from 2021 to 2024, and lost a 2024 race for California's 9th Congressional District. He is running on a platform that, per his campaign website, centers on the cost of groceries, gas and housing for Valley families.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Marine Corps; his campaign site notes he is a former member of the Marine Corps.
Earned an associate degree in business, a bachelor's degree in business management, and a master's degree in executive leadership.
Career experience includes working as a district manager with a private security company; Ballotpedia describes him as a security company executive and pastor.

Elected mayor of Stockton in November 2020, defeating incumbent Michael Tubbs 56.4% to 43.6% (57,276 to 44,206 votes); served from January 1, 2021, to December 31, 2024, and did not seek re-election in 2024.
Ran unsuccessfully for California's 9th Congressional District in 2024, losing to incumbent Josh Harder (D), 51.8% to 48.2%.
Advanced from the June 2, 2026, top-two primary in the 13th District after redistricting changed his district.
